interface.title: Invisible Hands: V&A Collections API Research Prototype
interface.field: Museum collections research / art and design history (archival and provenance research into craft labour)
interface.stage_of_work: Early triage: finding and ranking candidate catalogue records before going to the archives
interface.what_it_is_for: Search the Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A) Collections API, score each object record on how much catalogue evidence it carries for archival follow-up (an 'archival tractability' score from 0 to 9) with an evidence status, reasons and suggested next steps, filter by date, and export the enriched table as CSV.

data.note: Data came from the live V&A Collections API (api.vam.ac.uk/v2/objects/search, CSV response). The record counts depend on the sidebar settings in force, as reconstructed from the run's order of actions. Etruria: 33 records at the defaults (page size 45, Made after 1760 / before 1800, strict off, images not required); 13 after ticking Strict; 9 at 1780–1790 with strict on (screens/025.webp, screens/026.webp). Spitalfields: 89 records with page size 100, 'Only records with images' ticked, strict on and 1700–1800 (screens/034.webp); the replay found only 2 at page size 45 and the default 1760–1800. Flaxman: 76, then 40 after the Strict checkbox was toggled on (screens/046.webp). Both counts were with page size 100, images only, and the reversed range Made after 1850 / before 1800, which the app swaps to 1800–1850. The replay found 28 at the default 1760–1800 and 75 at page size 100 with images only. The app also ships 8 illustrative fallback rows, SAMPLE-001 to SAMPLE-008. All 8 showed under the run's 1700–1800 range; the replay saw 7 under the default 1760–1800. You can force the fallback rows with a checkbox (screens/036.webp). The app also switched to them on its own when a nonsense query returned no rows (screens/043.webp). No files were uploaded.

features.name: Rule-based evidence scoring with status, reasons and next steps
features.general: Score each record by which descriptive fields it has, give it a category label, list the fields that earned the score, and suggest what kind of research to do next. Then sort by the score to rank the records.
features.specific: Each V&A record gets an archival_tractability_score out of 9 and an evidence_status. The statuses are High archival tractability — requires archival follow-up, Catalogue-supported clue, Low metadata visibility, and Not assessable from catalogue alone. It also gets evidence_reasons ('maker name present; date present…') and archival_next_steps, which route to prosopographical, role-term, place-based, Wedgwood-related or object-led follow-up.
steps: Load records (live search or fallback sample)
Sort the Object records table by archival_tractability_score, highest first
Read evidence_status for the top-ranked records
Read evidence_reasons and archival_next_steps for the top-ranked records
serves_tasks: Rank records by how promising they are for follow-up

features.name: Result-set profile panel
features.general: Summarise the current result set at a glance: how many records, the average score, how many fall in each status category, and frequency tables of the most common makers and places.
features.specific: The Summary section shows Records loaded, Mean archival tractability score, Count by evidence_status, Top maker names and Top places. At the defaults for Etruria it read 33 records, mean 7.1, 26 High / 5 Catalogue-supported clue / 2 Low, Josiah Wedgwood and Sons 25, and Etruria 22. All of these update with the query, data source and date filter.
steps: Load records and set filters
Scroll to Summary and read Records loaded and the mean score
Read Count by evidence_status
Read Top maker names and Top places
serves_tasks: Get an overview of the result set

features.name: Free-text year-range filter with strict/lenient handling
features.general: Filter records by a start and end year parsed from free-text dates such as 'ca.1789' or 'late 18th century'. You choose whether records with dates that cannot be parsed are kept or dropped, and the filter catches a reversed range.
features.specific: The sidebar 'Local date filter' has Made after year and Made before year number inputs with steppers, plus a 'Strict date filtering' checkbox. Turning strict on cut Etruria from 33 to 13 records, and 1780–1790 left 9. A reversed range shows the warning 'the app will swap them for filtering'. The Summary and table update to the filtered set. Caveat: a filter that leaves zero records crashes the app instead of showing an empty result. In the replay, a swapped range with strict on raised KeyError 'archival_tractability_score' (check/screens/025.webp).
steps: Type or step the Made after year
Type or step the Made before year
Tick or untick Strict date filtering
Check the new Records loaded and evidence_status counts
serves_tasks: Keep only records made within a date range
Recover from a reversed date range

features.name: Live API search with visible request and automatic sample-data fallback
features.general: Query a remote collection API and show the exact request URL. If the API returns nothing, or offline mode is chosen, switch to bundled example rows and say so in a warning banner.
features.specific: The sidebar Search query, Page size slider (5–100) and 'Only records with images' build https://api.vam.ac.uk/v2/objects/search?q=…&page_size=…&response_format=csv[&images_exist=1]. The URL is shown in the 'API request' expander, and a green 'Using live V&A API data' banner confirms live mode. 'Use fallback sample data only', or an empty live response, switches to 8 illustrative rows. These come with the banners 'Fallback sample rows are illustrative and not authoritative V&A records' and 'No live API request was made'.
steps: Type a query and press Enter
Adjust Page size and the images-only filter
Expand 'API request' to check the URL
Tick 'Use fallback sample data only', or note the automatic fallback warning
serves_tasks: Search a collection database by keyword or place name

features.name: Scored record table with links to source catalogue pages
features.general: A table with one row per record, holding the descriptive fields and computed columns. Each row links to the record's full catalogue entry at the source institution.
features.specific: The Object records table holds the catalogue fields plus the four computed columns, and its object_page column links to the V&A item page (collections.vam.ac.uk/item/…). Sorting by header, in-cell Search with next/previous-result arrows, Show/hide columns and Fullscreen are supplied by the Streamlit data grid itself, not by this app.

Click a column header to sort
Press Search, type a term and use the next-result arrow to jump to the match
Press Show/hide columns and untick columns
Use the object_page link to reach the record's catalogue page (not followed in this run)
serves_tasks: Inspect the descriptive fields of each record

features.name: Enriched CSV export
features.general: Download the current filtered result set, including the computed columns, as a CSV file.
features.specific: 'Download enriched CSV' saves invisible_hands_triage_export.csv with 16 columns: the catalogue fields plus archival_tractability_score, evidence_status, archival_next_steps and evidence_reasons. It reflects the active query, data source and date filter. Columns hidden in the table are still exported.

Press Download enriched CSV
Open the CSV offline
serves_tasks: Save the scored table for offline work

features.name: Capped thumbnail gallery with record captions
features.general: Preview images for the first N records that have them, with title, maker, date and a link back to the source page. N can be set to zero to turn the preview off.
features.specific: The Thumbnails grid shows V&A IIIF images captioned with the title, 'Maker:', 'Date:' and a 'V&A object page' link. The Thumbnail limit slider (0–48, steps of 4) sets how many appear; at 0 the app shows 'Thumbnail preview is currently disabled.' Each image has a Fullscreen button, though the enlarged image stays thumbnail-sized.
steps: Scroll to Thumbnails
Drag the Thumbnail limit slider to set how many images show
Press Fullscreen on an image
Follow the V&A object page link

screens_never_reached: V&A object pages (the collections.vam.ac.uk links in the table's object_page column and under the thumbnails): an off-limits external site, so not opened. The hand-off from a ranked record to its full catalogue entry is therefore not traversed.
Real thumbnails in fallback mode: the sample rows' images showed as broken placeholders (screens/040.webp), apparently because the sample image IDs are not real
not_done: Crash when the filters leave zero records: in the replay of t6, with Strict date filtering still on, the swapped range left no rows and the app crashed with 'KeyError: archival_tractability_score' and a traceback (check/screens/025.webp). The 'No records match the current filters' message was never reached. The reviewer attributes this to enrich_records in app.py failing on an empty frame.
The built-in 'Download as CSV' button on the summary tables (Top maker names) gave no downloaded file in this browser. Only the app's own 'Download enriched CSV' button produced files.
The full archival_next_steps text is cut off in the table cells. I read it in full from the downloaded CSV, not in the interface.
The Streamlit main menu and the Deploy button are framework chrome, not part of the research workflow, so I did not use them.

Possible inconsistency, observed but not explored further: 'Only records with images' only filters the live API call. In fallback mode, records without images (e.g. SAMPLE-002) stayed listed while it was ticked (screens/038.webp, export).
No way to save or mark selected records for follow-up was found. Triage is limited to sorting, searching and exporting.
